fields.description: The workbook (BOQs) this suggestion run belongs to.
fields.label: BoQ

fields.description: The committed sheet name, VERBATIM (#152 -- never stripped).
fields.label: Sheet Name

fields.description: The committed sheet's commit_version at run time. VERSION KEYING: on page load a stored run only shows when this equals the sheet's CURRENT committed version (never suggest against rows that may have changed).
fields.label: Committed Version

fields.description: The run's job id (raw 32-char hash from the enqueue). Joins Use events (BoQ Rate Suggestion Event.run_id) back to their run.
fields.label: Run Id

fields.description: SR-1 run LIFECYCLE: running (created up front, results filling in) | partial (a batch halted; the rows attempted so far ARE saved and the run is resumable) | complete (every population row attempted) | failed. DISTINCT from ai_status, which stays its own 3-value vocabulary. 'Use this value' is enabled ONLY at complete. The default is 'complete' so pre-SR-1 rows backfill as complete on migrate and never retroactively lock Use; the worker always sets this explicitly, so the default never applies to a new run.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Whether the AI extraction voter actually ran: 'ran' | 'disabled' | 'no_key'. A fail-closed run (disabled/no_key) is still recorded honestly (no fallback extraction).
fields.label: AI Status

fields.description: The terminal per-row extraction payload: [{excel_row, attributes:{id:{value, confidence, corroborated}}}]. JSON. VALUES are always recomputed client-side from the CURRENT master/config -- only the extracted ATTRIBUTES persist here.
fields.label: Results

fields.description: SR-1 per-row DONE-MARKER: the excel_row numbers actually ATTEMPTED (a batch that returned). JSON list. This is what distinguishes 'not attempted' from 'attempted and the AI returned null' -- the two are byte-identical in results, so a resume MUST key off this, never off whether a row's attributes are blank. A halted batch's rows are NOT listed (they stay pending).
fields.label: Attempted Rows

fields.description: SR-1: why a partial run stopped, in plain language (e.g. the Anthropic usage limit). Persisted so the reason survives a page reload and can drive the resume affordance -- the pre-SR-1 opaque 'suggest_failed' error code could not.
fields.label: Halt Reason

fields.description: When the run terminated (success). Set by the worker.
fields.label: Run At

fields.description: Whether this is the live run for the sheet. FREEZE-AND-SUPERSEDE: a new run sets the prior active run for (boq, sheet_name) to active=0 (retained, never deleted). get_active_suggestion_run returns the active row only.
fields.label: Active
